summary_en: ROE 8.87% (FY3/26), WACC 3.48%, PBR 0.63x. FY3/27 guidance: ROE to decline slightly, WACC steady, PBR target above 1.0x. New metrics: revenue growth 7.5%, per-capita sales ¥28.75M, return rate 31.63%, new-business investment ¥170M. Four consecutive periods of net profit recovery (¥1,210M FY3/26).
summary_jp: ROE 8.87%（FY3/26）、WACC 3.48%、PBR 0.63倍。FY3/27見通し：ROEやや下降、WACC並み、PBR 1倍超へ努力。新指標：売上成長率7.5%、一人当たり売上高¥28.75M、返品率31.63%、新規事業投資¥1.70億。4期連続の当期純利益黒字化（FY3/26 ¥12.10億）。
